caption: A worker uses a wire brush wheel on a rusty gate, and sparks and rust flakes fly off the wheel in a fan.
expectation: The sparks leave tangent to the wheel, arc down, and go dark; the rust flakes fall and stay on the ground.

caption: Fireworks technicians test an igniter and it sparks briefly at the wire ends before the fuse catches.
expectation: The spark comes first at the wire ends, then the fuse glows and burns along its length; the spark itself does not persist.

caption: A cable car's wheel runs along an icy overhead cable, and small sparks flash at the contact.
expectation: The flashes are brief and at the contact point, moving with the car; they do not fall as embers.

caption: A machinist runs a lathe cutting steel, and glowing chips and sparks curl off the tool and drop into the tray.
expectation: The sparks and chips fall downward from the cutting point and darken as they cool; they appear only while cutting.

caption: A boy strikes two pieces of flint together in the dark, and a tiny spark jumps between them.
expectation: The spark appears at the point of impact at the instant of the strike and is gone; nothing glows before or after.

caption: An electric train's overhead line is coated in frost, and as the train moves off a series of flashes runs along the wire above it.
expectation: The flashes appear at the contact point and move with the train; each is brief; the wire does not stay lit.

caption: A worker chips a concrete floor with a steel chisel and hammer, and an occasional spark flicks from where the chisel strikes embedded stone.
expectation: Sparks appear only at some blows, at the point of impact, and are gone at once.

caption: A woman presses a small magnet against a refrigerator door and lets go, and the magnet stays stuck on the door.
expectation: The magnet holds on the vertical door with nothing else supporting it and does not slide down or fall; a photo tucked under it stays too.

caption: A boy holds a magnet just above a pile of paperclips on a desk, and the clips jump up and cling to the magnet.
expectation: The clips leap only when the magnet comes close and hang from it in chains; they fall when the magnet is pulled away.

caption: A man sweeps a magnet over a mix of nails and plastic beads spilled on the floor, and the nails stick to the magnet while the beads stay behind.
expectation: Only the nails lift; the plastic beads do not move; the nails cling to the magnet until pulled off.

caption: A girl places a sheet of paper over a paperclip and moves a magnet across the top of the paper, and the clip follows the magnet under the paper.
expectation: The clip moves exactly with the magnet, never passing through the paper; it stops when the magnet stops.

caption: A child slides a magnet along the underside of a thin wooden table, and a toy car with a metal base on top of the table follows it.
expectation: The car moves only where the magnet below moves and stays on the table surface; it does not move when the magnet is taken away.

caption: A cook holds a kitchen knife up to a magnetic strip on the wall, and the knife snaps onto the strip and stays there.
expectation: The blade jumps the last little gap and hangs on the strip without support; it does not fall until pulled off.

caption: A driver brings a phone near a magnetic mount on the dashboard, and the phone snaps onto the mount and holds.
expectation: The phone jumps the last bit of distance and stays in place while the car moves; it comes off only when pulled.

caption: A child pushes two toy train cars with magnetic couplers together, and they snap together and roll as one.
expectation: The cars pull together over the last gap and stay joined while rolling; they separate only when pulled apart.

caption: A child dangles a toy fishing rod with a magnet over a bowl of metal fish, and a fish leaps up and sticks to the magnet.
expectation: The fish lifts only when the magnet is close and hangs from it; it drops when shaken off.

caption: A man brings two bar magnets together end to end, and they snap together with a click.
expectation: The magnets pull together over the last short distance and stick; they do not drift apart once joined.

caption: A boy tries to push the like ends of two bar magnets together on a table, and the second magnet slides away from the first.
expectation: The free magnet moves away as the other approaches and stops when the gap is large enough; when one is flipped they snap together instead.

caption: A woman closes a cabinet door with a magnetic latch, and the door pulls itself shut the last inch and stays closed.
expectation: The door snaps closed just before it reaches the frame and does not swing open on its own afterward.

caption: A mechanic sets a magnetic parts tray on the side of a car and drops screws into it, and the tray and the screws stay put.
expectation: The tray holds on the vertical steel panel and the screws stick to its floor even when the tray is tilted; the tray does not slide down.

caption: A woman closes a handbag whose flap has a magnetic clasp, and the flap snaps down and holds.
expectation: The flap is drawn shut over the last small gap and stays closed until pulled open.

caption: A man lowers a horseshoe magnet over a steel key on a table, and the key jumps up and sticks to the magnet.
expectation: The key lifts when the magnet is close enough and hangs from the poles; it stays until pulled off.

caption: A magnet held to a refrigerator is slid down the door, and it slides and stays stuck the whole way.
expectation: The magnet moves only where the hand pushes it and stays on the door when released at any point; it does not drop off.

caption: A teacher sticks a sheet of paper to a whiteboard with a round magnet, and the paper hangs there.
expectation: The paper is held at the magnet's spot and hangs flat; it does not fall until the magnet is removed.

caption: A cook moves a magnet toward a steel saucepan on the counter, and the magnet jumps out of her fingers and clicks onto the pan.
expectation: The magnet leaps the last small gap and sticks; it stays on the pan when she lets go.

caption: A carpenter holds a screwdriver with a magnetic tip to a loose screw, and the screw clings to the tip and is lifted away.
expectation: The screw hangs from the tip while the driver is moved and does not fall until it is placed into a hole.

caption: A woman drops a steel washer near a strong magnet on a table, and the washer swerves toward the magnet and sticks to it.
expectation: The washer's fall bends toward the magnet only when close, and it clicks onto the magnet rather than landing where it was dropped.

caption: A child builds a tower with magnetic tiles, and each tile clicks onto the last and the tower stands.
expectation: Each tile is pulled into place over the last small gap and the assembly holds its shape when lifted.

caption: A boy tilts a travel chess board with magnetic pieces, and the pieces stay in their squares.
expectation: The pieces cling to the board even when it is steeply tilted; a non-magnetic coin placed on the board slides off.

caption: A scrapyard crane lowers a large round magnet onto a pile of scrap steel and lifts, and a clump of steel rises with it.
expectation: The steel pieces cling to the magnet's underside as it rises and drop all at once when the magnet is switched off over the truck.

caption: A woman pins a magnetic name badge to her blouse by placing the magnet inside the fabric, and the badge holds in place.
expectation: The badge stays put through the cloth without piercing it and does not slide down; it comes off only when the inner magnet is pulled away.

caption: A man swings a door until it reaches a magnetic doorstop, and the door snaps to the stop and holds open.
expectation: The door pulls onto the stop over the last small gap and stays there; it does not drift closed on its own.

caption: A girl holds a magnet near a compass, and the needle swings to point at the magnet; she takes the magnet away and the needle swings back.
expectation: The needle turns only when the magnet is near and follows it as it moves; it returns to its original direction when the magnet is removed.

caption: A man attaches a magnetic sign to the side of a steel van, and it stays flat against the panel as the van drives off.
expectation: The sign holds on the vertical panel without fasteners and stays in place in motion; it does not slide or fall.

caption: A child drags a magnetic wand over a tray of iron filings, and the filings clump onto the wand in fuzzy bristles.
expectation: The filings jump to the wand as it passes near and hang from it in spikes; they fall off when the wand is set down away from them.

caption: A woman drops a handful of steel pins near a magnet, and the pins swing toward it as they fall and stick along its sides.
expectation: The pins deviate from a straight fall only close to the magnet and end up clinging to it; those that fall far away land normally.

caption: A man hangs a magnetic hook on the side of a steel filing cabinet and hangs a coat on it, and the hook holds.
expectation: The hook stays on the vertical steel with the coat's weight and does not slide down or fall.

caption: A child holds a magnet against a plastic toy, lets go, and the magnet falls to the floor.
expectation: The magnet does not stick to the plastic and drops straight down when released; against a steel toy it would hold.

caption: A woman fastens a bracelet with a magnetic clasp, and the two ends jump together and hold.
expectation: The ends pull together over the last small gap and stay joined as her wrist moves.

caption: A man tosses a steel bolt toward a strong magnet fixed to a workbench, and the bolt swerves and clacks onto the magnet.
expectation: The bolt's path bends toward the magnet only when close and it stops dead on contact; a plastic bolt thrown the same way would fly past.

caption: A boy lowers a magnet on a string toward a metal bottle cap on the floor, and the cap jumps up to the magnet before it touches the floor.
expectation: The cap rises only when the magnet is within a short distance and hangs from it as the string is lifted.

caption: A shopper picks up a box of magnetic building blocks, and the blocks inside cling together in a chain when one is lifted out.
expectation: Lifting one block lifts those stuck to it in a hanging chain; the chain breaks where the pull exceeds the hold.

caption: A woman sticks a magnet to a steel lamp post and hangs a lost-cat poster from it, and the poster stays up.
expectation: The magnet holds the poster on the curved steel; the poster flaps in the wind but does not fall.

caption: A child moves a magnet in circles under a shallow dish of water with a paperclip floating on a piece of foam, and the clip follows the magnet around the dish.
expectation: The foam boat moves only where the magnet below moves and stops when it stops; the magnet stays under the dish.

caption: A man places a magnetic spirit level against a steel beam and takes his hands away, and the level stays on the beam.
expectation: The level holds on the vertical face without support and does not slide down.

caption: A child drops a magnet into a bowl of dry rice mixed with steel ball bearings, and when she pulls it out the bearings cling to it while the rice falls away.
expectation: Only the bearings come out on the magnet; rice grains fall back into the bowl.

caption: A woman closes a laptop, and its lid snaps shut over the last centimetre and stays closed thanks to the magnets inside.
expectation: The lid is drawn closed at the end of its travel and does not spring open on its own.

caption: A boy sticks a magnetic letter to a fridge, and it holds; he sticks one to the wooden cupboard next to it, and it falls off.
expectation: The letter stays on the steel door and drops straight down from the wood; the same letter behaves differently on the two surfaces.

caption: A mechanic reaches into an engine bay with a magnetic pickup tool, and a dropped nut clicks onto its tip and is lifted out.
expectation: The nut jumps to the tip when it is close and hangs from it as the tool is withdrawn; it does not fall until pulled off.

caption: A girl rubs a balloon on her hair and presses it against a wall, and the balloon stays stuck to the wall when she lets go.
expectation: The balloon holds on the vertical wall with nothing supporting it for a while, then may drift down slowly; it does not fall at once.

caption: A boy rubs a balloon on his sweater and holds it near his sister's head, and her hair rises toward the balloon.
expectation: The hairs lift toward the balloon only when it is close and follow it as it moves; they fall back when it is taken away.

caption: A child rubs a balloon on a wool jumper and lowers it over small torn scraps of paper on a table, and the scraps jump up and cling to the balloon.
expectation: The scraps leap only when the balloon is near and hang from it; some drop off after a while.

caption: A woman pulls a wool sweater off over her head in a dry room, and her hair stands up in all directions.
expectation: The hair rises as the sweater comes off and stays up for a moment before settling; it does not stand up before the sweater moves.

caption: A man pulls clothes out of a tumble dryer, and a sock clings to a shirt and has to be peeled off.
expectation: The sock stays stuck to the shirt as it is lifted, hanging on the fabric, and comes away with a pull; it does not fall on its own.

caption: A cook tears a sheet of plastic wrap from the roll, and it clings to her hand and folds onto itself.
expectation: The wrap sticks to her fingers and to itself where it touches, and has to be pulled free; it does not hang straight like paper.

caption: A woman opens a box of packing peanuts, and the foam pieces stick to her arms and to the sides of the box.
expectation: The pieces cling to skin and cardboard instead of falling off; they follow her arm as she lifts it.

caption: A boy shuffles across a carpet in socks and reaches for a metal doorknob, and he flinches as he touches it.
expectation: The flinch happens at the instant of contact with the metal, not before; a tiny spark may be seen at the fingertip.

caption: A child slides down a plastic playground slide, and at the bottom her hair is standing up from her head.
expectation: The hair rises during or right after the slide and settles slowly; it is flat before the slide.

caption: A woman pets a cat on a dry winter day, and the cat's fur stands up along its back and clings to her hand.
expectation: The fur lifts where her hand passes and follows the hand slightly; it settles after she stops.

caption: A man wipes an old television screen with a cloth, and dust and a few hairs jump onto the screen and stick.
expectation: The light specks are drawn to the screen after the rubbing and stay on it; they do not fall off at once.

caption: A child rubs a balloon on her hair and holds it over a tray of tiny foam beads, and the beads jump up to the balloon.
expectation: The beads leap only when the balloon is close and cling to it in a layer; they stay on when the balloon is turned over.

caption: A man gets out of a car on a dry day and touches the door frame, and he jerks his hand back from a shock.
expectation: The jerk happens exactly at the touch; there is no reaction before contact.

caption: A woman shakes out a fleece blanket in a dark bedroom, and small flickers of light run through the fabric.
expectation: The flickers appear only as the fabric separates and are gone at once; there is no glow while the blanket is still.

caption: A boy pulls off a wool hat, and his hair stays lifted in the shape of the hat's inside before slowly settling.
expectation: The hair rises as the hat leaves and drifts back down over a few seconds; it does not stand up before the hat moves.

caption: A woman in a light skirt walks across a carpeted room, and the skirt clings to her tights.
expectation: The fabric sticks to her legs instead of hanging free and stays clinging as she walks; it releases when she pulls it away.

caption: A man pulls a thin plastic bag off a roll, and it clings to his forearm and will not shake off.
expectation: The bag lies against his arm and stays when he shakes it; it comes off only when peeled.

caption: A child rubs a plastic ruler on her sleeve and holds it over torn bits of tissue, and the bits rise and stick to the ruler.
expectation: The bits lift only when the ruler is close and cling to it; an unrubbed ruler does nothing.

caption: Children bounce on a trampoline, and one girl's long hair stands up and floats around her head.
expectation: The hair rises after several bounces on the mat and drifts; it settles once she stops and touches the ground.

caption: A cook lifts a sheet of cling film off a bowl, and the film clings back to the bowl's rim and to her fingers.
expectation: The film sticks and stretches at the points of contact and has to be pulled free; it does not lift cleanly like paper.

caption: A boy rubs a balloon on his sweater and lets it go beneath the ceiling, and it floats up and sticks to the ceiling.
expectation: The balloon rises to the ceiling and stays there for a while; an unrubbed balloon released the same way falls to the floor.

caption: A girl rubs a balloon on her hair and holds it beside a tissue-paper ghost taped to a table, and the ghost lifts and leans toward the balloon.
expectation: The tissue rises toward the balloon when it is close and drops back when it is moved away.

caption: A man takes off a fleece jacket in the dark, and tiny sparks crackle where it pulls away from his shirt.
expectation: The sparks appear only as the fabrics separate and vanish instantly; nothing glows when he stops moving.

caption: A woman sits on a leather car seat in dry weather and then touches the metal seat-belt buckle, and she flinches at the shock.
expectation: The reaction is at the moment of contact with the metal; touching the plastic parts does nothing.

caption: A man in a wool sweater brushes past a hanging plastic shower curtain, and the curtain clings to his sleeve and follows him for a moment.
expectation: The curtain lifts toward the sleeve where it touched and trails after him briefly before falling back; it does not move before he passes.

caption: A woman takes a freshly printed stack of paper from a printer, and the sheets cling together and to her fingers.
expectation: The sheets stick and have to be fanned apart; a single sheet clings to the hand rather than falling.

caption: A woman lifts a fleece blanket out of the dryer, and a dryer sheet clings to its underside and rides along as the blanket is carried.
expectation: The sheet stays stuck to the fabric even when hanging upside down and comes off only when peeled; it does not drop on its own.

caption: A woman pulls on a synthetic blouse straight from the dryer, and it clings to her skin and rides up in wrinkles instead of hanging loose.
expectation: The fabric sticks to her arms and back and stays bunched where it touches; it settles only after she smooths it or it picks up moisture.

caption: A man unrolls a sheet of bubble wrap, and small bits of dust and fluff jump onto it from the table.
expectation: The fluff moves toward the plastic only when it is close and stays clinging; it does not move before the wrap is unrolled.

caption: A child removes a balloon that has been stuck to a wall for a while, and it comes away with a faint tug and the hairs on her arm rise toward it.
expectation: The balloon resists slightly before coming free and nearby fine hairs lean toward it; they settle when it is moved away.

caption: A woman brushes her long hair vigorously with a plastic brush, and strands lift and follow the brush as it moves away.
expectation: The strands rise toward the brush after several strokes and drift back when the brush is put down.

caption: A boy rubs a balloon on his head and places it against a wooden door, and the balloon slides slowly down and falls off.
expectation: The balloon holds briefly or slides down the wood and drops; it clings far less than it did to the painted wall.

caption: A man pulls a nylon jacket off a hanger in a dark closet, and faint flickers of light run across the fabric.
expectation: The flickers appear only as the jacket moves against itself or the hanger and vanish instantly.

caption: A woman peels a sticker from its backing sheet, and the backing clings to her fingers and curls toward the sticker.
expectation: The thin backing sticks to skin and has to be shaken or pulled off; it does not drop straight away.

caption: A child rubs a balloon on a sweater and holds it over a bowl of sugar, and a fine dusting of sugar jumps up to the balloon.
expectation: Only the finest grains lift and cling to the balloon; the bulk of the sugar stays in the bowl.

caption: A man shakes a woollen blanket out of the dryer, and a small sock flies off and lands on his arm and sticks.
expectation: The sock clings where it lands rather than sliding off; it comes away with a pull.

caption: A girl rubs a balloon on her hair and touches it to the tip of her nose, and a few strands of her hair lift toward the balloon.
expectation: The strands rise toward the balloon while it is close and fall when it is pulled back.

caption: A woman opens a bag of styrofoam beads and pours some into a bowl, and beads stick to the bag and to her hands rather than all falling in.
expectation: Some beads cling to the bag's sides and to skin while most fall; the clinging beads stay until brushed off.

caption: A man rubs his feet on a rug and touches his dog's nose, and the dog flinches and pulls back.
expectation: The dog reacts at the instant of touch, not before; the man's hand shows no lasting change.

caption: A child rubs an inflated balloon on the carpet and rolls it near a pile of fine sawdust, and sawdust jumps onto the balloon.
expectation: The dust leaps only when the balloon is close and coats the side facing the pile; it stays on as the balloon is lifted.

caption: A woman pulls a dry synthetic scarf from around her neck, and her hair crackles and lifts as the scarf comes away.
expectation: The hair rises as the scarf moves away and settles over a few seconds; it lies flat again afterward.

caption: A drummer hits a snare drum once with a stick, and the drum skin shivers visibly and then settles.
expectation: The skin starts moving at the moment of the strike, the shiver fades within a second or two, and the skin is still before and after; it does not keep growing or start before the stick lands.

caption: A guitarist plucks the low string of an acoustic guitar, and the string blurs into a wide band before slowly sharpening to a line again.
expectation: Only the plucked string blurs, the blur is widest right after the pluck and narrows steadily; the other strings stay sharp.

caption: A woman strikes a hanging gong with a padded mallet, and the gong's face trembles and its edges go fuzzy before calming.
expectation: The trembling begins at the strike, the gong swings slightly on its cord, and the shimmer fades gradually; it does not shake before being hit.

caption: A boy holds a steel ruler flat on a desk with part sticking over the edge, flicks the free end, and it waggles up and down before coming to rest.
expectation: The free end vibrates fast right after the flick with the tip blurring, the swings get smaller, and it stops within seconds; the part under his hand stays still.

caption: A child flicks a taut rubber band stretched between two nails, and the band blurs and hums before going still.
expectation: The band becomes a fuzzy band right after the flick and narrows back to a line; it does not start moving on its own.

caption: A diner taps the rim of a wine glass with a spoon, and the glass rings while its rim shimmers faintly.
expectation: The shimmer appears at the tap and fades; touching the rim with a finger stops it at once; the glass does not shatter from a light tap.

caption: A musician strikes a tuning fork against her knee, and the prongs blur into a soft haze that slowly clears.
expectation: The prongs blur only after the strike and sharpen over a few seconds; the handle stays sharp throughout.

caption: A man plucks a single string on an upright bass, and the thick string swings visibly from side to side before settling.
expectation: The swing is widest right after the pluck and shrinks steadily; the string stops when he lays a finger on it.

caption: A percussionist strikes a large cymbal, and the cymbal wobbles on its stand and its edge blurs before it steadies.
expectation: The wobble and blur begin at the strike and die away over several seconds; the cymbal does not move before the stick reaches it.

caption: A child bangs a metal pot lid with a wooden spoon, and the lid rings and quivers in her other hand.
expectation: The quiver starts at the bang and fades within a second or two; the lid is still before the spoon lands.

caption: A pianist presses a key on a grand piano with the lid open, and one string inside blurs while the hammer falls back.
expectation: Only the struck string blurs, right after the hammer hits; the blur fades when the key is released and the damper falls.

caption: A boy strikes a xylophone bar with a mallet, and the bar shivers on its cord for a moment.
expectation: Only the struck bar moves, starting at the hit and settling quickly; the neighbouring bars stay still.

caption: A woman plucks the string of a harp, and the string vibrates in a blur that narrows as the note fades.
expectation: The blur appears at the pluck and shrinks steadily to a sharp line; the other strings remain still.

caption: A man knocks on a thin sheet-metal door, and the panel visibly flexes and rattles under his knuckles before going quiet.
expectation: The panel moves at each knock and the rattle dies out between knocks; the door does not keep shaking after the knocking stops.

caption: A cook strikes a hanging metal triangle with a rod, and the triangle swings on its loop and its sides shimmer.
expectation: The shimmer begins at the strike and fades; the swinging is small and dies down; nothing moves before the rod touches it.

caption: A child flicks the tines of a fork held by its handle, and the tines blur briefly and then are still.
expectation: The blur starts at the flick and is gone within a second; the handle in the hand stays sharp.

caption: A woman taps a long wooden fishing rod against a post, and the tip whips back and forth in a blur before settling.
expectation: The tip's swings are large right after the tap and shrink steadily; the handle end barely moves.

caption: A boy slaps the surface of a taut trampoline mat with his hand, and the mat ripples outward and shivers before going flat.
expectation: The ripples spread from the slap and the shiver fades within a second or two; the mat is flat before the slap.

caption: A man plucks a stretched washing line, and the line blurs along its length and slowly sharpens.
expectation: The blur begins at the pluck and shrinks toward stillness; the clothes on the line sway slightly and settle.

caption: A child hits a suspended metal wind-chime tube with a stick, and the tube swings and its outline shimmers.
expectation: The struck tube swings and shimmers; neighbouring tubes move only if it bumps them; the motion dies down over a few seconds.

caption: A carpenter drops a long steel saw blade flat onto a bench, and the blade twangs and flutters for a moment before lying still.
expectation: The flutter starts at the impact and fades quickly; the blade does not keep quivering.

caption: A woman thumps the top of a large empty cardboard box, and the lid panel bounces and quivers before settling.
expectation: The panel moves at the thump and the quiver fades within a second; the box's sides barely move.

caption: A boy flicks a metal spring doorstop mounted on the wall, and it wobbles wildly and then slows to a stop.
expectation: The wobble is largest right after the flick and shrinks steadily; the base on the wall does not move.

caption: A musician taps the body of an acoustic guitar with her palm, and the strings tremble faintly in response before going still.
expectation: The tremble follows the tap and dies out; the strings do not move before the tap.

caption: A child strikes a hanging saucepan with a spoon, and the pan swings and its bottom shimmers.
expectation: The shimmer and swing begin at the strike and decay over a few seconds; the pan is still before.

caption: A man slaps a taut drumhead of a large bass drum, and the head visibly dips and rebounds several times, each time smaller.
expectation: The first dip is deepest, each rebound is smaller, and the head is flat within a couple of seconds.

caption: A woman plucks the wire of a garden fence, and the wire blurs and hums along its span before settling.
expectation: The blur is greatest at the plucked point and fades along the wire; it stops when the wire is gripped.

caption: A boy bangs a metal garbage-can lid against the can, and the lid rings and quivers in his hand.
expectation: The quiver starts at the bang and dies within a second or two; the lid is still before and after.

caption: A percussionist runs a mallet across the bars of a marimba, and each bar shivers in turn as it is struck.
expectation: Each bar moves only when the mallet reaches it and settles after; bars not yet struck stay still.

caption: A child plucks the thin elastic cord of a paddle ball toy, and the cord blurs and the ball bounces lightly before both go still.
expectation: The blur and bounce begin at the pluck and decay within a couple of seconds.

caption: A man strikes a hanging church-style handbell with its clapper, and the bell swings and its rim shimmers.
expectation: The shimmer begins as the clapper hits and fades; the swing settles; nothing moves before the clapper strikes.

caption: A woman flicks a strip of thin sheet metal clamped at one end in a vise, and the free end vibrates in a blur that slowly stops.
expectation: The free end blurs widest at the tip right after the flick and narrows to stillness; the clamped end does not move.

caption: A child strikes the taut skin of a tambourine, and the skin shivers and the metal jingles rattle before quieting.
expectation: The skin shiver and the jingle rattle both begin at the strike and fade together within a second or two.

caption: A man taps a thin metal lampshade with a pen, and the shade rings and its edge blurs faintly before settling.
expectation: The blur appears at the tap and fades within seconds; the lamp itself does not sway unless bumped.

caption: A glass of water sits on top of a large subwoofer, and when the music starts the water's surface breaks into fine ripples.
expectation: The ripples appear only when the music plays, pulse with the bass, and the surface goes flat when the music stops; the glass does not slide off.

caption: A heavy truck rumbles past a house, and the plates on a shelf by the window rattle against each other.
expectation: The rattling starts as the truck approaches, is strongest as it passes, and stops after it has gone; the plates do not rattle in a quiet street.

caption: A man slams a heavy door shut, and a picture frame on the nearby wall swings from side to side before hanging still.
expectation: The frame starts swinging at the slam, the swings grow smaller, and it stops within a few seconds; it does not move before the slam.

caption: Thunder rolls over a house, and the loose window panes buzz in their frames.
expectation: The buzzing coincides with the thunder and stops when it dies away; the panes are still in between.

caption: A washing machine spins up to full speed, and the bottle of detergent standing on top of it shakes and creeps toward the edge.
expectation: The shaking begins as the machine spins up, the bottle inches along in small jumps, and it stops moving when the spin cycle ends.

caption: A marching band passes close by, and the bass drum's beats make a shop's plate-glass window shiver with each hit.
expectation: The window's reflection wobbles in time with the drumbeats and steadies as the band moves away.

caption: A subway train roars through a station, and a hanging sign on the platform trembles on its chains.
expectation: The trembling starts with the train's arrival, is strongest as it passes, and fades after it leaves.

caption: A speaker on a table plays a loud bass track, and a handful of grains of rice scattered on the table jump and dance around it.
expectation: The grains hop in time with the beats, most strongly nearest the speaker, and lie still when the track stops.

caption: Fireworks explode overhead during a display, and the loose glass in a greenhouse below rattles with each bang.
expectation: Each rattle follows a burst and dies away before the next; the glass is still between bursts.

caption: A jackhammer starts up on a street, and the coffee in cups on a café terrace table shows rings of tiny ripples.
expectation: The ripples appear when the hammer runs and vanish when it pauses; cups farther away ripple less.

caption: A car with a booming stereo pulls up at a light, and its own rear-view mirror shakes visibly with the bass.
expectation: The mirror's image jitters in time with the beats and steadies when the music is turned down.

caption: A church bell rings in a tower, and the small loose panes of the belfry window quiver with each stroke.
expectation: Each quiver comes with a stroke of the bell and settles between strokes.

caption: A man switches on a loud table saw in a workshop, and the screws in a jar on the bench begin to rattle and shift.
expectation: The rattling begins when the saw starts and stops when it is switched off; the screws settle in a slightly different arrangement.

caption: A low-flying jet passes over a house, and a hanging light fitting in the hallway swings gently.
expectation: The swing starts as the jet passes and dies down over several seconds; the fitting is still beforehand.

caption: A subwoofer is turned up in a living room, and the picture frames on the wall behind it buzz and tilt slightly with the bass.
expectation: The buzzing follows the bass notes and stops when the music is cut; frames nearest the speaker move most.

caption: A drummer plays a hard rhythm in a small room, and a glass of water on a nearby amplifier ripples with each hit.
expectation: Each ripple ring appears with a drum hit and fades before the next; the surface is calm when the drumming stops.

caption: A stack of dry pasta sheets stands on a shelf above a running dishwasher, and the sheets buzz against each other while the machine runs.
expectation: The buzzing lasts as long as the machine runs and stops at the end of the cycle.

caption: A door slams in a hallway, and a set of keys hanging on a hook beside it swings and jingles.
expectation: The keys start swinging at the slam and settle within a few seconds; they hang still before.

caption: A powerful motorcycle revs its engine at a kerb, and the leaves of a potted plant on the pavement beside it quiver.
expectation: The leaves shake while the engine revs and go still when it idles down.

caption: A concert speaker stack blasts a bass note, and the fabric grille on its front visibly pulses in and out.
expectation: The grille flutters in time with the low notes and lies flat when the music stops.

caption: A man drops a heavy weight onto a gym floor, and the metal plates on a nearby rack ring and shiver.
expectation: The shiver starts at the impact and fades within a second or two; the plates are still before.

caption: A helicopter hovers low over a field, and the surface of a pond beneath it shivers into fine ripples.
expectation: The ripples appear while the helicopter is overhead and fade after it flies away; the water is calm before.

caption: Someone bangs a bass drum in a school gym, and a row of basketballs on a rack gently rock in their cradles.
expectation: The rocking begins with the drum hits and dies down after they stop.

caption: A loud speaker plays a rising bass tone next to a tray of sand, and the sand grains jump and shift into patterns.
expectation: The grains move only while the tone plays and stop when it stops; grains nearest the speaker move most.

caption: An excavator drops a load of rubble into a steel skip, and a nearby chain-link fence shivers along its length.
expectation: The shiver starts at the crash and fades within seconds; the fence is still before.

caption: A phone on vibrate buzzes on a glass table, and a spoon lying next to it rattles against the glass.
expectation: The spoon rattles in bursts with the phone's buzzes and lies still between them.

caption: A train crosses a metal bridge, and the water in a puddle on the road below shows shivering rings.
expectation: The rings appear as the train crosses and fade after it has passed; the puddle is still before.

caption: A stadium crowd stamps in unison, and the beer in a cup on a railing shows a steady wobble in time with the stamps.
expectation: The wobble matches the rhythm of the stamping and settles when the crowd stops.

caption: A large clock strikes the hour in a hallway, and a nearby vase of flowers trembles faintly with each chime.
expectation: The tremble comes with each chime and dies between chimes; the flowers are still when the clock is silent.

caption: A cook drops a heavy cast-iron pan onto a stovetop, and the lids of neighbouring pots rattle for a moment.
expectation: The rattle starts at the impact and stops within a second or two; the lids are still before.

caption: A speaker on the floor of a room plays a deep bass note, and a lit candle on the same floor flickers in time with the beats.
expectation: The flame flutters with each beat and burns steady when the music stops.

caption: A man revs a chainsaw in a garage, and the tools hanging on the pegboard behind him sway and tap against the board.
expectation: The tools move while the saw runs and hang still when it is shut off.

caption: A giant firework shell bursts over a lake, and the reflection on the water shivers into fragments a moment after the bang.
expectation: The reflection breaks up briefly after each burst and reforms as the surface settles.

caption: A large speaker's cone pumps in and out as a bass-heavy track plays, and it stops moving when the music is paused.
expectation: The cone moves in time with the beats, more on the low notes, and is still the instant the music pauses; it does not move in silence.

caption: A phone set to vibrate buzzes on a wooden table and creeps slowly across the surface until the buzzing stops.
expectation: The phone shivers and moves only while it buzzes, in small jerks; it stops dead when the vibration ends.

caption: An electric toothbrush is switched on and left lying on a bathroom counter, and it buzzes and slowly turns in circles.
expectation: The brush moves only while switched on and stops as soon as it is turned off.

caption: A man strikes a tuning fork and holds it up, and the prongs blur; he touches them to the table and the blur stops at once.
expectation: The prongs vibrate only after the strike and stop instantly when touched to a solid surface.

caption: A car engine idles roughly, and the whole hood trembles faintly until the driver switches off the engine.
expectation: The tremble lasts as long as the engine runs and stops within a moment of the ignition being turned off.

caption: A cellist draws her bow across a string, and the string blurs under the bow and sharpens the moment she lifts it.
expectation: The blur exists only while the bow moves on the string; the other strings stay sharp.

caption: A wind-up alarm clock rings, and its little hammer hammers between the two bells and the clock shivers on the table.
expectation: The hammer swings rapidly and the clock shakes only while it rings; both stop when the button is pressed.

caption: A hand-held massager is switched on and set on a bed, and it shudders and wanders across the sheet.
expectation: The shudder and wandering start with the switch and stop with it; the massager is still when off.

caption: A guitarist strums a chord, and all the strings blur together and then sharpen one by one as she damps them with her palm.
expectation: The blur begins at the strum and each string stops the instant the palm touches it.

caption: A blender runs on a kitchen counter, and its base vibrates and inches slightly across the counter until it is switched off.
expectation: The movement happens only while the motor runs and stops when it is turned off.

caption: A woman blows into a harmonica, and the reeds inside can be seen quivering through the openings while she plays.
expectation: The reeds move only while air is blown and are still between breaths.

caption: A lawnmower is started, and its handle shakes visibly in the operator's hands until the engine is cut.
expectation: The shaking lasts as long as the engine runs and stops when it is switched off.

caption: A drummer presses the bass drum pedal repeatedly, and the beater swings into the drumhead with each press and the head dips each time.
expectation: The beater moves only when the pedal is pressed and the head dips only when the beater lands; nothing moves between presses.

caption: A ringing old-fashioned telephone shakes slightly on its table, and the shaking stops when the handset is lifted.
expectation: The shaking coincides with the ringing bursts and ends the moment the handset is picked up.

caption: A violinist plays a long note, and the string under the bow is a blur that clears the instant the bow stops.
expectation: Only the bowed string blurs; the blur is present exactly while the bow moves.

caption: A washing machine on its spin cycle rocks and shudders on the floor, and it settles still as the drum slows to a stop.
expectation: The shuddering is strongest at full spin and dies away as the drum slows; the machine is still once the drum stops.

caption: A boy holds a running electric razor against his palm, and the razor's head buzzes and blurs until he switches it off.
expectation: The head blurs only while the razor runs and is sharp when it is off.

caption: A large bell in a tower is rung by a rope, and it swings back and forth with the clapper striking it on each swing.
expectation: The bell swings only while the rope is pulled and its swings die down once the pulling stops.

caption: A desk fan with a loose blade rattles and shakes on its base while running, and stops shaking when it is switched off.
expectation: The shaking lasts as long as the blades spin and stops as they come to rest.

caption: A trumpet player blows a note, and the bell of the trumpet trembles faintly while the note sounds.
expectation: The tremble appears while he blows and is gone when he stops.

caption: A pager on vibrate goes off on a nightstand and rattles against the wood until the owner picks it up.
expectation: The rattling and small movements happen only while it vibrates and end when it is lifted.

caption: A man plays a bowed cymbal with a violin bow, and the cymbal's edge shimmers while the bow moves and stills when he lifts it.
expectation: The shimmer exists exactly while the bow is drawn across the edge.

caption: A generator runs on a building site, and its frame shakes and the loose bolts on it rattle until it is shut down.
expectation: The shaking lasts as long as the engine runs and stops within a moment of shutdown.

caption: A child bangs on a toy piano, and the small hammers inside can be seen jumping up with each key press.
expectation: Each hammer moves only when its key is pressed and falls back after; hammers of unpressed keys stay down.

caption: A woman turns on a paint shaker at a hardware store, and the paint can clamped in it blurs with the shaking until the timer stops it.
expectation: The can blurs only while the machine runs and is sharp and still when it stops.

caption: A man plucks a single note on a banjo, and the banjo's head visibly quivers beneath the strings and then stills.
expectation: The quiver begins at the pluck and fades within a second or two.

caption: A dentist's drill is switched on and held up, and its tip becomes a blur until the pedal is released.
expectation: The tip blurs only while the drill runs and is sharp when it stops.

caption: A hand-cranked siren is wound faster and faster, and its casing vibrates more as the pitch climbs, then settles as the crank slows.
expectation: The vibration rises and falls with the cranking speed and stops when the crank stops.

caption: A cook uses a stand mixer on high, and the whole mixer trembles on the counter until she turns it down.
expectation: The trembling is strongest on high and eases as the speed is lowered; it stops when the mixer is off.

caption: A man taps a microphone on a stand, and the mic head jiggles on its clip with each tap.
expectation: The jiggle begins with each tap and settles before the next; the mic is still without tapping.

caption: An old refrigerator compressor kicks on, and the fridge shudders briefly and a magnet on its door quivers.
expectation: The shudder happens as the compressor starts and settles into a faint hum; it stops when the compressor cuts out.

caption: A bagpiper plays, and the drones resting on his shoulder tremble faintly while the note holds.
expectation: The drones tremble only while air flows through them and are still when he stops.

caption: A child sets a wind-up music box going, and the metal comb inside can be seen plucked tooth by tooth as the cylinder turns, until the spring runs down.
expectation: The teeth flick only as the pins pass them, the cylinder slows gradually, and everything stops when the spring is spent.
